outcomes.answer: Yes, it is true that the human body has 206 bones. Textbooks frequently report that there are 206 human bones, or 200 bones and 6 auditory ossicles. The relatively low modern reckoning of 206 was due to exclusion of teeth and sesamoid ossicles, and to reassessments of the hyoid, sacrum, coccyx, and sternum as unitary bones.
